Privacy policy

Updated 1 October 2026 · Version 2026-10-01

This policy explains the personal data Smerch uses, why, and your rights. Purchasing or accepting sales terms is not consent to marketing.

Controller

Smerch is operated by Trykeksperten ApS, Danish company registration no. 44015773, Raffinaderivej 10e, 2300 København S, Denmark. Contact hello@smerch.dk or +45 27 82 22 77.

Data, purposes and legal bases

  • Orders and delivery: Name, email, phone, address, business details where relevant, goods, quantities, designs and correspondence are used to process orders, deliver and provide support. The basis is GDPR Article 6(1)(b) where you are the contracting party, or Article 6(1)(f) for business contacts, with a legitimate interest in administering customer relationships.
  • Payment and accounting: Amounts, payment references, status and invoice information are processed to complete purchases under Article 6(1)(b) or (f), and to meet accounting obligations under Article 6(1)(c). Payment providers handle card details; our checkout does not receive your full card number or security code.
  • Artwork and proofs: Files, text, images and approvals are used to produce and document the agreed goods under Article 6(1)(b). For data about other people, we assess Article 6(1)(f) and the interest in fulfilling production. Do not submit national identification numbers or sensitive data. Where we act solely on a business customer's instructions, roles and necessary processing agreements must be established separately.
  • Enquiries: Contact details and messages are used to respond under Article 6(1)(b) for pre-contract enquiries, or Article 6(1)(f) for relevant customer service.
  • Operations and security: IP addresses, technical connection data and necessary logs may be used to operate and protect the site, troubleshoot and prevent abuse under Article 6(1)(f). We do not collect data solely because it might become useful later.
  • Legal claims: Necessary records may be retained for specific complaints and disputes under Article 6(1)(f), or to meet a legal obligation under Article 6(1)(c).

Data normally comes from you, but a purchaser may supply your delivery details. Providers supply payment, production and delivery status. We cannot fulfil purchases without necessary order and delivery information.

Optional marketing

You may choose offers, product news and inspiration from Smerch (Trykeksperten ApS) about merchandise, branded clothing, printing and custom production. Email and SMS are selected separately. Providing a phone number alone does not authorise SMS or sales calls. Purchasing and customer service do not depend on signing up.

We process the selected contact details and evidence of consent, including date, channel, wording and version, under GDPR Article 6(1)(a) and applicable marketing consent rules. This does not authorise other companies' marketing, tracking or profiling.

Withdraw free of charge through Unsubscribe, the option in a message, or hello@smerch.dk. Withdrawal does not affect earlier lawful processing. Necessary evidence of previous consent and withdrawal may be retained for claims under Article 6(1)(f). Necessary order service messages may continue.

Recipients

We use one.com for email and Render for hosting. Online payments use Quickpay and the relevant acquirers/payment methods. Stripe may process earlier Stripe payments. PF Concept and relevant production and shipping providers receive what is necessary for production and delivery, including artwork and, for direct dispatch, delivery details. Accountants, auditors, legal advisers and authorities may receive data where necessary and lawful.

Processors act on instructions under processing agreements. Some recipients are independent controllers for their own purposes, including payments or statutory records. Product images may load from PF's image server, which receives technical connection information from your browser. We do not sell your information for advertising.

Processing outside the EU/EEA

Render is a US provider although the site is configured for Frankfurt. Providers' international operations and support can involve processing outside the EU/EEA. Render describes standard contractual clauses and relevant adequacy mechanisms in its data protection terms. Transfers may only occur on a valid GDPR basis, such as an applicable adequacy decision or EU standard contractual clauses with necessary additional safeguards. Contact us for recipient details and a copy of relevant safeguards. We do not promise exclusively EU storage. See Render's processing terms and one.com's processing agreement.

Retention

Accounting records are normally retained for five years after the end of the relevant financial year. This does not automatically cover all artwork, drafts or messages.

Other data is retained according to purpose: enquiries while the case or offer is relevant; production files while production, delivery or a relevant complaint requires them; necessary contract and proof records while applicable complaint or limitation periods and specific claims require them. Records are then assessed for deletion or anonymisation; irrelevant records are not kept merely because other records remain necessary. You may request an assessment of your data.

Marketing contact details are used while consent is valid. Unsubscribing stops marketing use; limited evidence is retained where necessary to demonstrate earlier lawful use and handle claims. Suppression data respects your opt-out. Technical logs are retained for operational and security needs, with relevant extracts retained longer for specific incidents. Backups expire according to the applicable backup cycles. We do not promise permanent artwork archiving.

Cookies and browser storage

Your browser stores the cart, language and work in progress locally; artwork may be stored in IndexedDB. Some data has no automatic expiry and stays until removed by you, your browser or the site. Checkout also uses session storage. Clearing site data in browser settings may remove your cart and design. Staff login uses a session cookie lasting up to eight hours.

Marketing signup does not authorise analytics or advertising cookies. If these are introduced, any required separate consent must be obtained before use. Normal site translation does not send your designs to a translation service.

Your rights

Subject to statutory conditions you may access, correct, erase, restrict or obtain portability of your data and object to processing based on legitimate interests. You may always object to direct marketing and withdraw consent. Erasure can be limited by accounting duties or necessary legal claims.

Write to hello@smerch.dk. We may request information necessary to verify identity. We normally respond within one month and explain any lawful extension. You may complain to the Danish Data Protection Agency.

Automated decisions and changes

Our webshop does not make automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects. Ordinary price calculations are not such decisions. Payment providers describe their own processing in their notices. We update this policy when processing changes; the date and version appear above.
